senses.gloss: m. (עבט, v. עֲבוֹט; cmp. חֶבֶט I) [fastening, pressing,]

(של גמל) sumpter-saddle consisting of a pair of panniers tied across the animal’s back (Lat. clitellae, Gr. κανθήλια); also the cushion on the camel’s back (Arab. gabiṭ). Sifra M’tsor‘a, Zab., Par. 2, ch. III; Kel. XXIII, 2; a. e.—Pl. עֲבִיטִין.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 3:1">Tosef. Erub. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 2:1">II</cite>), 1; <cite ref="Eruvin 16a:1">Erub. 16ᵃ</cite> top; Y. ib. I, 19ᵇ bot.—Tanḥ. Emor 18 <he>עביטות</he>. v. <cite ref="P00028"><he>עֲבוֹט</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: ע׳ של ענבים (cmp. κανθήλια) a large basket, strapped on the carrier’s back, in which grapes are carried during the vintage.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:7">B. Mets. V, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 72b">72ᵇ</cite>); Tosef. ib. VI, 2.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 3:13">Tosef. Maasr. III, 13</cite> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="P00028"><he>עבוט</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:11">Tosef. Dem. VI, 11</cite>; Y. ib. VI, 25ᶜ bot. <cite ref="P00037"><he>עֶבֶט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 5:1:7">Y. Bets. V, beg. 62ᵈ</cite> <he>העבט</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 10:4">Toh. X, 4</cite>, sq. <he>העביט</he> ed. Dehr. (ed. <he>העבט</he>; Ar. <cite ref="M02053"><he>מעבט</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 2:1:5">Y. M. Kat. II, beg. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>דורכין את עַבְטוֹ</he> you may press, for the mourner, the grapes in the basket (to prevent ruin by delay); a. e.

senses.gloss: ע׳ של מימי רגלים a large vessel for the collection of urine (for manufacturing purposes).
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 25b:16">Ber. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>גרף של רעי וע׳ וכ׳</he> a vessel for the collection of excrements, and a tub for urine; <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 2:16">Tosef. ib. II, 16</cite> Var.
<cite ref="Ketubot 82b:12">Keth. 82ᵇ</cite>, read with Tosaf.: <he>ע׳ של נחושת</he> a bronze tub.
